=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:776-950 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Several Semble query-builder helper functions in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh are defined but never called by any live judge path.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified the same dead-code block, with qwen covering the earlier helper section and moonshot/x-ai covering the later build_* helpers.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:178-232 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble prefetch contract test no longer robustly verifies the live wiring because it mixes function-definition checks with live-path assertions and removes the positive guard for the scaffolding.
  WHY: All three reviewers flagged the test as weakened or ambiguous; moonshot noted it only checks function existence, qwen called out the removed positive assertions, and x-ai said the contract is inconsistent.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:182 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts that 'append_judge_semble_query_text()' exists in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, but x-ai reports that no such function is defined there.
  WHY: This is a standalone claim from x-ai at line 182 and was not merged with the other test-contract findings because it describes a different root cause.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:149 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: render_judge_semble_prefetch_from_query_file is reported to pass the query file into semble_query_block without enforcing JUDGE_SEMBLE_QUERY_MAX_BYTES.
  WHY: Only x-ai raised this line-149 concern; the other reviewers explicitly disputed it.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7-8 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The shellcheck source directive points at scripts/semble_helpers.sh, but the conditional sourcing may leave ShellCheck coverage ambiguous.
  WHY: Only qwen reported this as a potential static-analysis coverage issue.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:795-829 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: extract_diff_file_summary silently stops after 40 changed files without signaling truncation to callers.
  WHY: Only qwen reported the silent 40-file cap and the lack of caller-side awareness.

- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:178-192 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Removing the positive assertions for build_semble_prefetch_block(), build_wave_judge_semble_query(), build_stall_judge_semble_query(), build_review_blocked_judge_semble_query(), and build_integration_conflict_judge_semble_query() removes the test guard for that scaffolding.

  WHY: The reviewer said the negative assertions and the phantom append_judge_semble_query_text() check do not correctly verify the live judge path.
